notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. Governing documents: Faculty Code and Governance ch. 51 (Faculty Leave and Vacations; capture 2018-03-14) and Faculty Code ch. 24 (capture 2018-02-10). The AHR pages (captures 2018-02 to 2018-05), the 2015 Leave Comparison Chart, the 2015 FMLA Information Summary and the September 2017 School of Medicine Family Friendly Packet are summaries; the Code governs where they differ (source precedence). Tenure-stream faculty are not unionised (version note on 2018_02).

Holds no policy of its own: 2018_11 (promotion/tenure postponements and denials; no parental or leave provision); 2018_12 is a leaves index page (only the tenure-waiver sentence, used for c10, and a note that extension lecturers have a collective agreement, not saved and not covering tenure-stream faculty); 2018_09 holds only the part-time appointment rules (c13) and the <50% rule (24-41 E) relevant here.

No paid parental leave: the only pay around a birth is Faculty Sick Leave (Code 51-01), 90 calendar days per July-June year at full salary, for the birth parent's own pregnancy/childbirth disability (generic plan, V1 not met) and, under the Family Care Act, for a non-birth parent caring for the birth parent during incapacity. The packet: 'there is no current paid leave for adoptive parents'.

Faculty sick leave coded as pay alone (U6: 'salary shall be continued'; a non-accruing annual allotment like Tufts R1), not as a leave of absence. Its leave status is the AHR's pregnancy disability leave (c4) with FMLA. Alternative reading (sick leave as a 90-calendar-day leave plus pay within, U6) would add ~12.9 protected weeks before FLA for the birth parent. The coding as pay alone stands under U6, because the policy continues salary without granting a leave of absence of its own; the alternative is recorded here for users who read it otherwise.

Birth parent chain: pregnancy disability leave (c4, certified period, no length; Faculty Sick Leave c1 pay concurrently, up to 90 calendar days; FMLA c2 concurrent from the start) -> Washington FLA bonding leave c5 (12 weeks, consecutive_after c4, overlapping FMLA). Separately, Faculty Code family leave c3 (normally up to 2 quarters / 6 months, unpaid) with FMLA concurrent from its initiation; c3 is not linked to c5 (no text says they add).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA c2 (12 workweeks) concurrent with FLA c5 (12 weeks) and with the Faculty Code family leave c3 (up to 2 quarters / 6 months, unpaid); Family Care Act sick-leave pay c6 (up to 90 calendar days) concurrent with FMLA, only while caring for the birth parent during her incapacity.

Sequence conflict: the 2015 Leave Comparison Chart says Parental Leave & Leave Without Salary follows exhaustion of sick leave, FCA and FMLA/FLA; Faculty Code 51-11 C runs FMLA from the initiation of the family leave and says its benefits are 'not additive' to FMLA. The Code governs (c3 flagged conflicting_sources).

Tenure clock: the governing Faculty Code (51-21) has only the elective waiver of time on family or sick leave (c8). The automatic birth/adoption waiver of a year (c9), the life-event waiver (c10) and the automatic waiver of a year with <50% work for six months (c11) appear only on AHR pages and the packet: flagged summary_only; the Code chapter on tenure (ch. 25) is cited but not saved.

Not components: Domestic Violence Leave (RCW 49.76; cannot be used for a birth); military leave; workers' compensation; Paid Professional Leave and Vacation (named only in the packet's list, no terms saved); disability accommodation through the Disability Services Office (any disability); lactation stations, childcare and CareLink (services, not leave); continuation of employer health contributions during FMLA or sick leave (benefits, not pay); employee-paid long-term disability insurance premiums are mentioned only as a payroll deduction, with no plan terms, so no LTD component.

Calendar: the Faculty Code states 'two successive academic quarters' and the AHR page shows Autumn/Winter/Spring/Summer quarters: quarter system, without a stated length, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order.

Cross-references not saved: Washington Family Leave Act (RCW 49.78); Washington Family Care Act (RCW 49.12.270); RCW 49.76; RCW 38.40.060; Faculty Code Chapter 25 (Sections 25-32, 25-51, 25-52), Chapter 23 (23-45), Chapter 13 (13-31); Executive Orders No. 29, 32, 45, 59, 64 and V; Administrative Policy Statements 41.1 and 45.5 (and the APS linked from the LWOP page); FMLA Information Summary 2016 version; UW HR Benefits and Work Life 'Family Friendly Policies' page; the extension lecturers' collective bargaining agreement; leave certification forms.
